title: Supply Chain Planning Administrator FTC
description:
Noble Foods Home of the Happy Egg Co.

Noble Foods is a family-owned company which began in 1920 and includes successful milling, poultry, agriculture, and consumer foods businesses. Within this, Noble Foods owns several successful brands, including the UK s biggest free-range egg brand the Happy Egg co., Big & Fresh and Purely Organic.

In a recent survey by Best Companies we were rated as one of the Top 10 companies to work for in the Food and Drink industry.

What are we looking for?

About the role:

To ensure the accurate and timely processing of sales orders and effective coordination across internal departments and the supply chain. The role is responsible for maintaining excellent customer service, resolving queries, and supporting operational efficiency through clear communication and reporting.

Key Accountabilities of the role What I do IT

(The below is not exhaustive)

Accurately raise and manage manual sales orders, including any amendments or updates.

Communicate order details and changes effectively to Production, Transport, and other relevant departments.

Monitor orders through the supply chain, ensuring timely progress and resolution of any issues.

Act as a key point of contact for customer queries, complaints, shortages, and order-related issues, ensuring prompt resolution.

Provide administrative support to Supply Chain Planners and the wider team.

Produce and share service level reports and performance data with stakeholders as required.

Maintain accurate records and documentation, including raising purchase orders and confirming orders for equipment or services.

Use Microsoft Office tools (particularly Outlook and Excel) effectively to manage workloads and reporting.

Provide out-of-hours support where required, including cover for weekends, holidays, or sickness absence.

Shared Accountabilities Making it better together US

Health & Safety responsibilities
- Follow the health and safety policies and procedures.
- Report any hazards, incidents, or injuries to the team leader or manager.
- Use the personal protective equipment and clothing provided.
- Cooperate with the team leader or manager on health and safety matters.
- Participate in health and safety training and induction.

Social & Environmental responsibilities
- Demonstrate awareness of the social and environmental impact of your work and strive to minimise any negative effects.
- Follow the company's policies and guidelines on sustainability, ethics, diversity and inclusion, and health and safety.
- Support your team members and collaborate with other colleagues to achieve the company's social and environmental goals.
- Seek opportunities to learn and improve your skills and knowledge on social and environmental issues relevant to your role.

About You: How I do it ME

Skills, Knowledge & experience

Strong organisational and administrative skills with high attention to detail

Excellent communication and customer service skills

Ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment

Experience in order processing, supply chain, or logistics (desirable)

Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel

Personal attributes

Works Together and collaborates with others to complete tasks and solve problems

Takes Ownership for the quality and timeliness of their work

Is Courageous and does what they know is right even if its uncomfortable

Takes Action and does everything in their ability to deliver what has been promised

Contributes to a trusting team by treating everyone with Respect and showing kindness to all colleagues

Strives for Excellence and takes every opportunity to learn new skills

Key Stakeholders

Internal:
- Sales & Marketing
- Production
- Logistics

External:
- Customers
- Transport Providers

We believe the most successful teams are formed from a diverse talent pool and we strive to employ a wide variety of individuals in our business, selecting the best qualified person for each role regardless of age, disability, gender, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation or any other protected characteristics.

- Free hot drinks on shift
- Service Awards
- Enhanced paternity and maternity
- Free life insurance
- Enhanced Sick Pay Scheme
- Access to Perkbox with a variety of discounts including a monthly freebie from Greggs or Café Nero

- Access to DigiCare + - Annual Health Check, Digital GP Consultations, Nutritional Consultations, Second Health Opinion and Mental Health Consultations.
- Discounted Gym Memberships

- Share in our success with the People Partnership - after 6 months service you will be eligible for a yearly bonus

If you consider yourself to require reasonable adjustments to any part of our recruitment process, we invite you to share those requirements with us when completing your application. We will make every effort to ensure your needs are met to provide a fair and transparent process of assessment.

title: Quality Co-ordinator
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Permanent Quality Co-ordinator - Grimsby 37.5 Hours Per Week Flexible Working Hours

Hays are delighted to be exclusively partnering with a well-established manufacturing organisation based in Grimsby, conveniently located close to major motorway links, to recruit a Quality Coordinator.

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and detail-oriented individual with experience supporting Quality Management Systems (QMS), ISO 9001 or similar standards, document control, compliance or quality administration within a manufacturing or regulated environment.

The Role
Working as part of the Quality function, you will play a key role in maintaining and supporting the Quality Management System, ensuring documentation and records are accurate, compliant and readily accessible.
You will coordinate customer incident investigations, support internal audits, maintain quality records and assist with the production of certification and compliance documentation to ensure customer requirements are met.
This is a varied position offering exposure to quality systems, auditing, compliance and continuous improvement activities across multiple sites.

Key Responsibilities

Maintain and support the Quality Management System (QMS)
- Ensure quality procedures, records and controlled documents are accurate and up to date
- Coordinate document reviews, updates and revision control processes
- Support internal audit programmes and monitor corrective actions
- Coordinate customer incidents and support investigations through to closure
- Analyse quality data and identify trends or areas for improvement
- Produce and maintain certification and compliance documentation
- Support Quality training and induction activities
- Maintain quality-related information within business systems
- Support customer representatives visiting the site and liaise with internal stakeholders
- Assist the wider quality team with compliance and quality improvement activities

About You
We are keen to speak with candidates who have:
- Experience working in a Quality, Compliance, Document Control or Quality Administration role
- Previous exposure to a Quality Management System such as ISO 9001 or similar
- Strong administration and organisational skills
- Excellent attention to detail
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
- Strong communication skills and confidence in dealing with internal and external stakeholders
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications

Desirable Experience
- Internal auditing experience
- ISO 9001 auditing experience
- Experience within a manufacturing, engineering or regulated environment
- Knowledge of SAP or similar business systems
- Experience supporting investigations, corrective actions or continuous improvement activities

What's on Offer?
Permanent opportunity
- 37.5 hours per week
- Flexible working hours
- Core hours of 9am-3pm, with flexibility to work between 7am-7pm
- Opportunity to develop a career within Quality and Compliance
- Supportive and collaborative team environment
- Exclusive opportunity managed by Hays Recruitment

Additional Information
Due to the location of the site, applicants must have access to their own vehicle.If you have experience supporting quality processes, quality systems or ISO standards and are looking for your next challenge within a growing manufacturing environment, we'd love to hear from you.

What you need to do now

If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

description: This recruitment covers the role of an Assistant Administrator on a fixed term contract until 18th October 2027. The post holder will have skills in the respective areas of administrative functions to enable them to support the patient pathway, using Standard Operating Procedures (SOP's) to ensure that functions of the roles are carried out correctly within given timescales. We therefore support and encourage open conversations around a specific working pattern to suit your work-life balance or a multi-role career, if it works for you and works for the role, we'll do our best to make it happen. Local flexible working arrangements are developed in partnership between the line manager and employee in order to ensure equality of access to flexible working, as far as practicable, regardless of role, shift pattern, team or pay, based on: patient/service user and staff experience, service delivery and work-life balance of colleagues. title: Administrator
description: Abbey Medical Practice is seeking a motivated and organised Administrator to join our busy practice team. Monday to Friday 8am to 4pm (37.5 hours a week). This is an excellent opportunity for an individual with strong administrative skills who enjoys working in a healthcare environment and making a positive difference to patient care. The successful candidate will provide essential administrative support across referral management, clinical coding and patient registrations, ensuring accurate patient records and efficient practice processes. Referrals: Process referrals generated by clinicians using NHS referral system. Submit and track referrals to hospitals, community services and diagnostic providers. Liaise with patients and secondary care providers regarding referral queries. Monitor referral tasks and ensure referrals are processed within required timescales. Clinical coding: Review and code clinical correspondence, hospital letters and reports within SystmOne. Extract relevant diagnoses, procedures and clinical information from correspondence. New Patient Registrations: Process new patient registrations and deductions. Manage patient record transfers and registration queries. Ensure registrations are completed in accordance with NHS guidance and practice procedures. To provide a high-quality, efficient and confidential referral management service to clinicians and patients within the practice. The Administrator is responsible for processing referrals accurately and promptly, ensuring patient are referred appropriately to secondary care, community services, diagnostic services and other healthcare providers in accordance with practice procedures and NHS guidelines. To be responsible for the accurate and timely coding of clinical information within the Practice's electronic patient record system (SystmOne). The post holder will review and code patient correspondence, hospital letters, diagnostic results and other clinical documentation using appropriate clinical coding standards to ensure patient records are complete, accurate and support safe patient care, QOF requirements, enhanced services and contractual reporting. The Clinical Coder will work closely with clinicians and the administrative team to maintain high standards of data quality, confidentiality and information governance, contributing to the effective management of patient care and Practice performance.
